Question Choices: Find the least nonnegative remainder of 7^21 modulo 20.
Hints: Square and reduce after every step; combine powers according to the binary expansion of the exponent.
Solution: Repeated squaring modulo 20 gives 7^1 ≡ 7; 7^2 ≡ 9; 7^4 ≡ 1; 7^8 ≡ 1; 7^16 ≡ 1. Since 21 = 1 + 4 + 16, multiply the corresponding residues 7 * 1 * 1 and reduce modulo 20 to obtain 7.

Question Choices: Find the least nonnegative remainder of 12^17 modulo 35.
Hints: Square and reduce after every step; combine powers according to the binary expansion of the exponent.
Solution: Repeated squaring modulo 35 gives 12^1 ≡ 12; 12^2 ≡ 4; 12^4 ≡ 16; 12^8 ≡ 11; 12^16 ≡ 16. Since 17 = 1 + 16, multiply the corresponding residues 12 * 16 and reduce modulo 35 to obtain 17.
